description: Run by .github/workflows/renovate.yml (manual while the repository is private).
Covers GitHub Actions (SHA pins), the docs site (docs/source, pnpm) and mise.toml.
Checksum-pinned downloads (Android NDK, Mono.Cecil, coverlet.console) and vendored sources (Lua, LuaJIT, LuaSocket, luaunit, ios-cmake) are updated by hand; see .github/CI.md.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the cooldown and are never automerged.

postUpgradeTasks.description: Tools/dependencies.py reads workflows, mise.toml and docs/source/package.json, so every update regenerates the inventory that native-build.yml checks.

prBodyNotes: DEPENDENCIES.md and sbom.cdx.json were regenerated with `python3 Tools/dependencies.py`. Its hand-checked LATEST tables were not changed, so a bumped row can read `behind` until the next inventory refresh.

packageRules.description: Majors are separate PRs that wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
A new Python minor (3.15) is a new language line, so it waits for approval too.
Workflow changes use the ci type.
One PR for non-major action updates.
Runner labels are moved by hand (compiler and SDK versions change with the image).
ghcr.io has no release timestamps, so the cooldown would hold the Renovate image back forever. Its tags follow the npm package, which has them.
One PR for non-major docs site updates (Astro, Starlight, pnpm).
engines.node is a support floor, not a pin.
mise.toml and devEngines.runtime in docs/source/package.json must name the same Node.js, so they move in one PR.
